translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Daaneelanne Aa Heezu Laggetsatuwaa
Yihudaa Kaatii Yo'ak'eemi kaateteedda heezzentso laytsi, Baabloone Kaatii Naabukadanas'oori Yerusaalame katamaa bolla denddiide, he katamaa dooddeedda.

Goday Yihudaa Kaatiyaa Yo'ak'eemanne S'oossaa Geeshsha Golliyaan de'iyaa miishshatuwaappe unddenneeddawaa Aa kushiyan aatsiide immeedda. Ikka he miishshatuwaa Baabloone gadiyaan de'iyaa bare s'oossatuwaa eek'aa golliyaa aheedda; bare s'oossaa miishshaa minjjiyaa golliyaan wotseedda.

Hewaappe guyyiyaan, kaatii Ashifanaaza giyaa bare oosanchchatuwaa kaappuwaa hawaadan yaagiide azazeedda; «Israa'eeliyaa asaa giddoppe kaatiyaa zare gidiyaawanttanne wolk'k'aama asatuwaa zare gidiyaawantta doora.

Yalagatuu asatetsan pac'ay bayinnawantta, malanchchatuwaa, ayaa tamaarissooppekka eranaw danddayiyaawantta, akeekiyaawantta, eratetsay kumeeddawanttanne kaatiyaa golliyaan ootsanaw danddayiyaawantta. Unttuntta Baabloonetuwaa k'aalaanne s'ifatiyaa tamaarissa» yaageedda.

K'ay unttunttu hachchi hachchi maana k'umaynne ushana woyniyaa eessay kaatiyaw ka"eedda k'umaappenne ushshaappe gidanaadan, kaatii azazeedda. Hewaadankka, heezzu laytsaa looheeddawaappe guyyiyaan, kaatiyaa sintsa shiik'iide, oosuwaa doommanaadan k'achcheedda.
Dooretteeddawanttu giddoppe Yihudaa zare gidiyaawanttu Daaneela, Hanaaniyaa, Mishaa'eelanne Azaariyaa giyaawanttu de'iino.
Oosanchchatuwaa kaappuu unttunttu suntsaa laammiide, Daaneela Bils's'aasoora, Hanaaniyaa Sidiraak'a, Mishaa'eela Misaak'a, Azaariyaa Abddanaago giide suntseedda.
Daaneeli kaatiyaa k'umaa miyaawaaninne woyniyaa eessaa ushiyaawan barena tunissenna mala, bare wozanaan k'ofaa k'achcheedda; he k'ofaan mayyanaadan, oosanchchatuwaa kaappuwaa woosseedda.
He kaappuu Daaneela sabbana malanne aw k'arettana mala, S'oossay ootseedda.

Gido shin, oosanchchatuwaa kaappuu Daaneelaw odiidde, «Taani hinttenttoo ha k'umaanne ushshaa azazeedda ta godaa kaatiyaw yayyay. Hinttenana laggetiyaa yalagatuu som"uwaappe hintte som"ii gilk'k'i beettooppe, hintte gaasuwaan kaatii taana wod'ana» yaageedda.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, oosanchchatuwaa kaappuu suntsina Daaneela, Hanaaniyaa, Mishaa'eelanne Azaariyaa hadaraa akkeedda bitaniyaa Daaneeli hawaadan yaageedda,
«Nuw maanaw ataakilttiyaa, ushanawukka haatsaa s'alalaa immaade, nuuna ne k'oomatuwaa tammu gallassatuwaan paac'c'a.
Hewaappe guyyiyaan, nu som"uwaanne kaatiyaa k'umaa miyaa yalaga asatuwaa som"uwaa geedara s'eellaade, nuuna ne k'oomatuwaa new malati beetteeddawaadan ootsa» yaageedda.
I hewaa mayyiide, tammu gallassaa unttuntta paac'c'eedda.
Tammu gallassaappe guyyiyaan unttunttu, kaatiyaa k'umaa meedda yalagatuwaa ubbaappe pas'iidenne ank'k'ariide beetteeddino.
Yaatina, unttunttoo giigeedda k'umaanne woyniyaa eessaa diggiide, ataakilttiyaa immeedda.
Ha oyddu yalagatoo S'oossay eraanne ubbaa k'ommo s'ifatiinne timirttii geliyaa akeekaa immeedda. Daaneeli k'ay sas'aanne akumuwaa ubbaa biletsaa eree.
Kaatii yalagatuu barekko gelanaaddan azazeedda wodii polettina, oosanchchatuwaa kaappuu unttuntta Naabukadanas'oore sintsa aatseedda.
Kaatii unttuntta haasayisseedda wode, Daaneela, Hanaaniyaa, Mishaa'eelanne Azaariyaa mala Asay unttunttu giddon beettibeenna. Yaatina, unttunttu kaatiyaw ootsanaw geleeddino.
Kaatii unttuntta oochcheedda ay aad'd'eeda eratetsaanne akeeka ooshaan, Aa kawutetsan de'iyaa shareechchotuwaappenne muruniyaawanttu ubbaappe unttunttu tammu kushiyaa aad'd'iide beetteeddino.
Daaneeli Kaatii K'iiroose kaateteedda koyiro laytsay gakkanaw gam"eedda.
